resumeText:
Priya Raghavan | Chennai | priya.raghavan@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Medical Coder - ED Profee, Kaveripattinam Health Services (fictional), Chennai (2021 - present)
- Assign ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes and CPT codes for emergency department profee charts of a US hospital client.
- Code E/M levels for ED visits using the current E/M guidelines.
- Apply modifier 25 and modifier 59 where documentation supports it and clear NCCI edits before sign-off.
- Use anatomy and medical terminology knowledge to code fracture, burn and injury cases to the highest specificity.
- Use the 3M encoder to validate code selection and HCPCS supply codes.
- Maintain 96% coding accuracy and 80 charts per day against client accuracy targets.

EDUCATION
BSc Microbiology, Madras Christian College, 2020

CERTIFICATIONS
CPC, AAPC (2021)

SKILLS
ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, PHI handling, MS Excel
